research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: bankmestika.co.id HTML pages sit behind a Cloudflare challenge (403 'Just a moment...') for this server; they were read only through Internet Archive snapshots (reports page 2025-09-15, IR page, privacy notice, homepage 2026-09-10). Every PDF under bankmestika.co.id/img/ downloads directly with a browser User-Agent (no challenge), so all source_url values are the bank's own files, fetched directly on 2026-11-03. Files newer than the last archived reports page (AR2025, FY2025 OJK publication, AGMS 2025/2026 results, 9M2025 report) were located by web search; the 9M2026 report (LPTKSeptember2026.pdf) was found by requesting a few plausible file names on the bank's own server after the 2025 naming pattern. idx.co.id (Akamai, 403) was not used. Details in sources.md.

ENTITY / BASIS: PT Bank Mestika Dharma Tbk has no subsidiaries (AR2024 PDF p. 92: 'sampai saat ini tidak mempunyai anak perusahaan'); its audited statements are titled 'Laporan Keuangan' (not konsolidasian). The parent PT Mestika Benua Mas (89.44%), which also owns 90% of BPR Prima Tata Patumbak, publishes consolidated statements that are bound into the same AR (e.g. AR2025 PDF pp. 573+; AR2024 PDF pp. 593+) and fill the 'Konsolidasian' columns of the bank's newspaper publications (FY2025: total assets 16,718,981 vs bank 16,665,331 Rp juta). Those parent figures are NOT used. Money fields use the bank's own audited statements with basis 'consolidated' (the validator requires it for profit/equity; same convention as MEGA.json); ratios are the bank's OJK-format ratios, basis 'bank_only'. Equity attributable = total equity (no NCI).

CORPORATE ACTIONS: none in 2019-2026 - no split, reverse split, rights issue or bonus issue since the 2013 IPO (which was a secondary offering of 430,000,000 existing shares by PT Mestika Benua Mas, so the bank received no proceeds). AR2025 PDF p. 15: 'Bank belum pernah melakukan aksi korporasi yang menyebabkan perubahan pada saham, seperti pemecahan saham, penggabungan saham, dividen saham, saham bonus, perubahan nilai nominal saham, penerbitan efek konversi, serta penambahan dan pengurangan modal'; AR2024 PDF p. 11 says the same for 2024; the 9M2026 OJK report still prints 4,090,090,000 issued shares. corporate_actions is therefore empty, and fy.2019.year_end_price is not needed (no rights/bonus before 2020-12-31). Only treasury-share movements occurred (not corporate actions in this schema): buyback of 357,300 shares in 2019 and about 62.8m in Apr-Jun 2020 (63,133,900 held at end-2020; the IR 'Keterbukaan Informasi Refloat' describes the 2020 programme as 63,021,200 shares for Rp69,016,572,150, average Rp1,095, 17 Apr-12 Jun 2020, i.e. the position after the 2021 sale), sale of 112,700 in 2021 and 2,055,800 in 2024 (FS2025 Note 21, AR2025 PDF p. 520); 60,965,400 held since end-2024. A disclosure dated 30 Apr 2026 (same IR file) announced a plan to re-sell the treasury shares (it still quotes 63,021,200); none had been sold by 30 Sep 2026 (treasury-stock line unchanged at Rp66,765m).

PER-SHARE BASIS: no share-basis change ever, so EPS, DPS, prices and share counts are directly comparable across years. EPS uses weighted-average shares net of treasury; shares_out = issued 4,090,090,000 less treasury shares at FY end (FS share-capital note). EPS x shares_out is within 1.2% of profit in every year (FY2020 is the widest because of the mid-2020 buyback).

YEAR-END PRICES - REVIEWER MUST CHECK: the AR share tables are captioned 'Sumber: yahoo finance' and are internally inconsistent. The 'Terendah/Low' and 'Tertinggi/High' columns are swapped in several years (e.g. AR2025 p. 15: Q4-2025 'Low' 2,150, 'High' 1,935), the Q2-2024 open is printed as 5,960 in AR2024 (2,020 in AR2025), and three Q4 closes are not on the IDX tick grid: FY2020 1,548, FY2022 2,033 and FY2024 1,987 - so they cannot be traded closes (probably Yahoo dividend-adjusted closes). The printed market capitalisations imply different year-end prices for FY2022 (Rp2,120), FY2023 (Rp2,000 vs 1,950 printed) and FY2024 (Rp1,930). Following the brief the printed closes are stored with these conflicts in each note; expect price_year_end mismatches for FY2020/2022/2023/2024 once prices/BBMD.json exists, to be checked against the IDX close and acknowledged (precedent: BDMN/BSIM) or the AR value replaced by the owner. FY2021 (2,000) and FY2025 (2,050) are consistent with the printed market values. No price file was fetched in this research (Yahoo returned HTTP 429 for one diagnostic request; nothing from it is used). The stock is extremely illiquid (89.44% held by the parent; quarterly volumes as low as 14,200 shares in Q1 2024, AR2024 PDF p. 11).

DIVIDENDS: exactly one final cash dividend out of each of FY2020-FY2025, approved at the AGMS after year end; no interim or special dividends (dividend policy: only final dividends, Kebijakan Dividen 22 Mar 2024). FY2019 and FY2018: no dividend (AR2020 PDF p. 136: profit retained; outside the window anyway). Dates come from the AGMS result announcements; the AR dividend tables (AR2021 p. 136, AR2022 p. 137, AR2023 p. 138, AR2024 p. 131, AR2025 p. 118) contain several wrong recording/payment dates (e.g. FY2022 recording '15 Mei 2023', before the 7 Jun 2023 AGMS) and AR2023 prints FY2022 DPS Rp34.26 vs Rp34.27 in the AGMS announcement - the announcements are used. Totals are the amounts actually paid per the FS cash-flow statements (FY2025: OJK 9M2026 report). Payout ratio is printed only for FY2023 (33.08%); FY2024's printed 39.3% contradicts the bank's own amounts (34.2%) and is left null; other years print no ratio.

NOT DISCLOSED (null): cost of credit (all years and interim), loan at risk FY2020-FY2025 (the 'Kredit Kualitas Rendah' line appears only in the 2026 OJK quarterly template; 9M2026 8.55% stored), NPL coverage (all years and interim; only 'CKPN aset keuangan terhadap aset produktif' is printed), interim CASA, payout ratio FY2020-FY2022, FY2024, FY2025. Nothing was computed.

RATIO SOURCES: FY2023-FY2025 from the AR2025 ratio table (PDF pp. 13-14), FY2022 from AR2024 (PDF pp. 9-10), FY2021 from AR2023 (PDF p. 16), FY2020 from AR2022 (PDF p. 16; AR2020 itself has no CIR line). Overlapping years in AR2020-AR2025 are identical. ROE is the OJK published-report ROE as printed; the ARs also print a lower 'Rasio laba (rugi) terhadap ekuitas' (e.g. 5.87% for 2025) which is not used. CASA = 'Rasio Dana Murah'. LDR above 100% in FY2024 (105.28) and FY2025 (102.12) and 9M2026 (104.74) is real: loans 10,834 / deposits 10,291 bn at end-2024.

PDF TEXT: the audited FS pages of AR2021 (PDF pp. ~395-640) have a font encoding where every glyph is shifted by -29 code points; the text was decoded with scripts/deshift.py (shift +29) and the numbers checked against the 2021 comparatives in AR2022 (identical). Units: FS in full Rupiah, AR highlights and OJK reports in Rp juta - all converted to IDR bn.

RESTATEMENTS: none found. Each year's comparatives in the next AR equal the originally reported figures (checked total assets, equity, profit 2019-2024). PSAK 71 was adopted on 1 Jan 2020 through an opening-balance adjustment at 1 Jan 2020 (AR2020 PDF p. 405, statement of changes in equity) without restating 2019. Fixed-asset revaluations (2015, 2018, 2019, 2022, 2025) go through OCI.

PROFIT TREND: net profit fell from Rp523.1bn (FY2022) to Rp320.0bn (FY2025) and 9M2026 profit is down 18% YoY (Rp202.4bn vs 247.9bn) with impairment charges up to Rp88.0bn (9M2025: 2.7bn) and NPL gross up to 2.19% (Sep 2025: 1.08%) - real movements per the OJK reports, not unit slips.

AUDITORS: FY2020-FY2022 KAP Paul Hadiwinata, Hidajat, Arsono, Retno, Palilingan & Rekan (AGMS 2021/2023 summaries); FY2023 KAP Leonard, Mulia & Richard (report 00095/3.0010/AU.1/07/0313-1/1/III/2024 dated 22 Mar 2024, AGMS 2024 summary); FY2024-FY2026 Budiadi Widjaja of KAP Leonard, Mulia & Richard (re-appointed at the 2025 AGMS for FY2025 and at the 2026 AGMS). The 9M2026 report is unaudited ('Emiten tidak diaudit').

INTERIM: 9M2026 = OJK quarterly publication 'Laporan Publikasi Keuangan Triwulanan' for 30 Sep 2026 (APOLO format, published 29 Oct 2026, unaudited). A full interim financial statement with notes for 30 Sep 2026 was not found on the bank's site; the share count therefore comes from the 9 Jun 2026 AGMS summary plus the unchanged treasury-stock line. Prior-period loans and deposits come from the 9M2025 publication (LPTKQ32025.pdf).
KBMI: 1 (core capital Rp5.39tn at end-2025, below the Rp6tn KBMI 2 threshold; AR2025 states the goal of reaching KBMI 2 before 2028).
